basics.name: Thanet Arnont
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer & System Architect
basics.summary: Seasoned Software Engineer and System Architect with 20+ years of continuous production experience since 2004. Built enterprise-grade systems for Thailand's top telecom, banking, and government sectors — including national-scale real-time auction platforms and financial compliance systems. Now focused on modern full-stack development, AI-driven platforms, and developer tooling with Next.js, TypeScript, React, and MCP integration. Available for consulting through Wisdom Vast Co., Ltd.

work.name: Wisdom Vast Co., Ltd.
work.summary: Architecture and hands-on delivery for Thailand's telecom, government, and enterprise sectors.
highlights: Led development of 15+ production applications for AIS (Thailand's #1 telecom): gamification, knowledge management, e-service, and CRM platforms
Built the NBTC Digital TV Spectrum Auction — national-scale real-time bidding with WebSocket engine and government-grade audit trail
Delivered the Off-Budget Accounting System for the Ministry of Finance: fund tracking, multi-level approvals, compliance reporting
Shipped 5 production platforms in 2026: Hauction, SDLC_AI, Programming Visualize, Drawing Game, GitlabSelfhost
Built a production MCP server (31 tools) for AI collaboration; automated GitLab migration of 1,000+ projects

work.name: Advance System Consulting
highlights: Built the Treasury Risk Management System for Krungthai Bank — risk calculations, regulatory reporting, and multi-level approval workflows

work.name: DTAC (Total Access Communication)
highlights: Researched and developed mobile network services; studied global mobile technologies
Integrated vendor test systems and developed system connection interfaces

education.institution: King Mongkut's Institute of Technology Ladkrabang (KMITL)

projects.name: Programming Visualize (MongoModel Editor)
projects.description: Visual MongoDB schema designer with drag-and-drop canvas, relationship modeling, 8-format code generation, workspace-wide linting, and an MCP server (31 tools) so AI agents work from the same data as the web UI.

projects.name: Hauction — Hybrid Auction Platform
projects.description: Multi-shop platform with dual auction engine (live event + long-term marketplace), 5-role permission hierarchy, KYC approval workflows, and full Thai Baht localization.

projects.name: SDLC_AI — AI-Driven SDLC Platform
projects.description: Guides software projects from requirements to deployment with AI feedback at every stage; multi-role dashboards via GitLab OAuth with intelligent gap detection.

projects.name: pi-agent / hermes-agent — Codeless Domain Q&A Agents
projects.description: Question-answering systems built for organisations working with dense, specialised material. Configured rather than coded, and deliberately not a conventional local RAG: instead of returning retrieved passages, the agents reason across the material so questions that require analysis come back with an answer.

projects.name: GitlabSelfhost — Migration & Inventory
projects.description: Automated enterprise GitLab migration: structured CSV schema, logic-based mapping, bulk operations across instances with validation and rollback — 1,000+ projects processed.

projects.name: NBTC Digital TV Spectrum Auction
projects.description: National-scale real-time auction platform for digital TV spectrum licensing: multi-bidder WebSocket engine, state machine lifecycle, government-grade audit trail.
